fusions.name: Mouser's Spring
fusions.desc: Springs you onto a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Worry the Wound
fusions.desc: Swipes a cone 2 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to each enemy in it. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Padding Close
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. You move 22% faster, enemies notice you 75% later, and the veil breaks when you attack.

fusions.name: Second Swipe
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
